title: A wanke, yanayi, shimfiɗawa da kwancewa kafin a yi waƙa
course_title: Kula da Gashi & Salon Sauƙaƙe: Ayyukan Sabis na Salon

say: A wanke, yanayi, shimfiɗawa da kwancewa kafin a yi waƙa.
Wannan shine bidiyon don module 2 na Kula da gashi da Salon Sauƙaƙe.
Kyakkyawan riguna masu ɗorewa suna farawa kafin ɓangaren farko. Dole ne gashin ya zama mai tsabta, mai sharadi, kuma a kwance ba tare da tsinke igiyoyi ba.

say: Kuna iya shimfiɗawa da zafi. Busasshiyar damp, ba digo ba, gashi akan mafi ƙarancin zafi da ke aiki, tare da kariyar zafi, motsa na'urar bushewa daga tushe zuwa ƙarshen. Idan gashi yana warin kone ko kuma ƙarshen ya ji kutsawa, zafi ya yi yawa.

say: Don tunawa. Gwada ruwan a wuyan hannu. A wanke a sassa. Goge, kar a shafa, kuma a bushe gaba daya kafin a yi kwakwa. Mikewa tare da ƙaramin zafi ko zaren zaren. Detangle gashi mai laushi a cikin ƙananan sassa, daga ƙarshe zuwa sama.
Tare da kawuna masu taushi da yara, ɗauki hutu da yin ajiyar lokaci maimakon gaggauwa.
